# Traffic flow data

```{r}
traffic_raw =  read.csv("traffic_weather_full2020.csv", sep = ",", header = T)

# column names
names(traffic_raw)

# rows
head(traffic_raw)

str(traffic_raw)

# See what's actually in the "5 Minutes" column
head(traffic_raw$X5.Minutes, 5)

```

```{r}

# What is the timestamp column called?
names(traffic_raw)

# First 10 timestamps exactly as they appear in the file
head(traffic_raw$X5.Minutes, 10)

# Last 10 timestamps
tail(traffic_raw$X5.Minutes, 10)

# How many rows?
nrow(traffic_raw)

# Are there duplicated timestamps?
sum(duplicated(traffic_raw$X5.Minutes))
```

```{r}
traffic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = mdy_hm(X5.Minutes, tz = "UTC"), 
    hour = hour(datetime)
  ) %>%
  group_by(hour) %>%
  summarise(avg_flow = mean(Flow), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  #arrange(desc(avg_flow)) %>%
  #head(10)
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = avg_flow)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Traffic Flow by Hour of Day",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Average Traffic Flow"
  )
ggsave("average_traffic_by_hour.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)  

```

## The plot illustrates the average traffic flow across of the hours of the day. The traffic volume gradually increases from early morning around 5 AM, peaking in the late afternoon to early evening (around 7 PM), and subsequently decreases during the night.

```{r}
# Preparing the data
traffic_clean <- traffic_raw %>%
  mutate(datetime = mdy_hm(X5.Minutes, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  select(datetime, Flow, holidays) %>%
  rename(Traffic_flow = Flow)

head(traffic_clean)
dim(traffic_clean)

# Which timestamps are missing?
traffic_clean %>%
  mutate(dt_diff = datetime - lag(datetime)) %>%
  filter(dt_diff != as.difftime(5, units = "mins"))
```

# Training data subset from April 1(2020) to May 31(2020)

```{r}
# Training data subset: April 1 - May 31, 2020
traffic_subset <- traffic_clean %>%
  filter(
    as.Date(datetime) >= as.Date("2020-04-01"),
    as.Date(datetime) <= as.Date("2020-05-31")
  ) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = datetime)

traffic_subset %>% scan_gaps()
  
```

# Fill missing timestamps and linearly interpolate Traffic_flow (as an integer count)

```{r}

traffic_subset %>%
  fill_gaps() %>%
  filter(
    datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-01 09:40:00", tz = "UTC"),
    datetime <= as.POSIXct("2020-04-01 10:10:00", tz = "UTC")
  )

# Linear Interpolation
#Fill missing timestamp and interpolate as an integer count

traffic_subset <- traffic_subset %>%
  fill_gaps() %>%
  mutate(
    Traffic_flow = as.integer(round(  ### We ant integer!
      na.approx(Traffic_flow, na.rm = FALSE)
    ))
  )

traffic_subset %>%
  filter(
    datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-02 09:40:00", tz = "UTC"),
    datetime <= as.POSIXct("2020-04-02 10:10:00", tz = "UTC")
  )

traffic_subset %>% scan_gaps()
```

# Aggregate the 5-min data to obtain 10-min dataset

```{r}

traffic_10min <- traffic_subset %>%
  index_by(datetime_10 = ~ floor_date(.x, "10 minutes")) %>%
  summarise(Traffic_flow = sum(Traffic_flow, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(datetime = datetime_10)

cat("Total 10-min observations:", nrow(traffic_10min), "\n") 
cat("Any NAs?", sum(is.na(traffic_10min$Traffic_flow)), "\n") 

```

# Observe how the aggregation is done

```{r}
traffic_subset %>%
  filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-2 09:45:00", tz = "UTC"))

traffic_10min %>%
   filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-2 09:45:00", tz = "UTC"))

cat("Total 10-min observations:", nrow(traffic_10min), "\n") # 8784

```

# Plotting 5mins and 10 mins(aggregated) data for 2 weeks

```{r}
p1 <- traffic_subset %>%

    datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-01 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
    datetime <= as.POSIXct("2020-05-31 00:00:00", tz = "UTC")

  autoplot(Traffic_flow) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(200, 1500)) +

print(p1)

traffic_10min %>%

    datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-01 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

flow_df <- traffic_10min %>% as_tibble()

simple_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
line_col <- "steelblue"

# ---- (a) Full 10-minute series ----
p_series <- ggplot(flow_df, aes(x = datetime, y = Traffic_flow)) +
  geom_line(colour = line_col, linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 week", date_labels = "%d %b") +
  labs(title = "10-minute traffic flow, April–May 2020",
       x = NULL, y = "Traffic flow") +
  simple_theme

# ---- (b) One-week snippet (Monday 6 – Sunday 12 April 2020) ----
week_df <- flow_df %>%
  filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-06 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
         datetime <  as.POSIXct("2020-04-13 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"))

p_week <- ggplot(week_df, aes(x = datetime, y = Traffic_flow)) +
  geom_line(colour = line_col, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%a %d %b") +
  labs(title = "One week of 10-minute traffic flow, 6–12 April 2020",
       x = NULL, y = "Traffic flow") +
  simple_theme

# ---- (c) Average daily profile ----
daily_profile <- flow_df %>%
  mutate(tod = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
  group_by(tod) %>%
  summarise(mean_flow = mean(Traffic_flow), .groups = "drop")

p_daily <- ggplot(daily_profile, aes(x = tod, y = mean_flow)) +
  geom_line(colour = line_col, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 3),
                     labels = sprintf("%02d:00", seq(0, 24, 3))) +
  labs(title = "Average daily profile",
       x = "Time of day", y = "Average traffic flow") +
  simple_theme

# ---- (d) Average weekly profile ----
weekly_profile <- flow_df %>%
  mutate(dow   = wday(datetime, week_start = 1),            # 1 = Monday
         hours = (dow - 1) * 24 + hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
  group_by(hours) %>%
  summarise(mean_flow = mean(Traffic_flow), .groups = "drop")

p_weekly <- ggplot(weekly_profile, aes(x = hours, y = mean_flow)) +
  geom_line(colour = line_col, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks       = (0:6) * 24 + 12,
    labels       = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"),
    minor_breaks = (0:7) * 24,
    limits       = c(0, 168), expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Average weekly profile",
       x = NULL, y = "Average traffic flow") +
  simple_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3))

print(p_series); print(p_week); print(p_daily); print(p_weekly)

ggsave("series_10min.pdf",          p_series, width = 9, height = 3.5)
ggsave("week_snippet_10min.pdf",    p_week,   width = 9, height = 3.5)
ggsave("daily_profile_10min.pdf",   p_daily,  width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave("weekly_profile_10min.pdf",  p_weekly, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

short_df <- traffic_10min %>% as_tibble()

short_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
short_col <- "steelblue"

# ---- (e) Three-day snippet: daily seasonality ----
days3_df <- short_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-06 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
                datetime <  as.POSIXct("2020-04-09 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"))

p_days3 <- ggplot(days3_df, aes(x = datetime, y = Traffic_flow)) +
  geom_line(colour = short_col, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.POSIXct(c("2020-04-07", "2020-04-08"), tz = "UTC"),
             colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "6 hours", date_labels = "%a %H:%M") +
  labs(title = "Three days of 10-minute traffic flow, 6–8 April 2020",
       x = NULL, y = "Traffic flow") +
  short_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ---- (f) Two-week snippet with weekends shaded: weekly seasonality ----
weeks2_df <- short_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-04-06 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
                datetime <  as.POSIXct("2020-04-20 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"))

weekends_df <- data.frame(
  start = as.POSIXct(c("2020-04-11", "2020-04-18"), tz = "UTC"),
  end   = as.POSIXct(c("2020-04-13", "2020-04-20"), tz = "UTC")
)

p_weeks2 <- ggplot(weeks2_df, aes(x = datetime, y = Traffic_flow)) +
  geom_rect(data = weekends_df,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey90") +
  geom_line(colour = short_col, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%a\n%d %b") +
  labs(title = "Two weeks of 10-minute traffic flow, 6–19 April 2020 (weekends shaded)",
       x = NULL, y = "Traffic flow") +
  short_theme

print(p_days3); print(p_weeks2)

ggsave("days3_10min.pdf",  p_days3,  width = 9, height = 3.5)
ggsave("weeks2_10min.pdf", p_weeks2, width = 9, height = 3.5)
```


# ACF and PACF plots

```{r}
# ACF and PACF plots
p1 <- traffic_10min %>%
  ACF(Traffic_flow, lag_max = 3000) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "ACF of 10-min Traffic Flow", x = "Lag (10-min intervals)", y = "ACF") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 288)) +   # every ~2 days (144 = 1 day)
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(144, 1008), linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

p2 <- traffic_10min %>%
  PACF(Traffic_flow, lag_max = 3000) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "PACF of 10-min Traffic Flow", x = "Lag (10-min intervals)", y = "PACF") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 288)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(144, 1008), linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2, heights = c(1, 1))

pdf("ACF_PACF_10min_original.pdf", width = 14, height = 9)  # TODO: re-enable for report export
ggsave("ACF_10min_original.pdf", p1, width = 14, height = 5)
grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)
dev.off()
```

# ACF and PACF after differencing ( removing daily seasonality , shows weekly seasonality)

```{r}
p1<- traffic_10min %>%
  mutate(diff_144 = difference(Traffic_flow, lag = 144)) %>%
  ACF(diff_144, lag_max = 3000) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "ACF of 10-min Traffic Flow (Differenced at Lag 144)", x = "Lag (10-min intervals)", y = "ACF") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 288)) +   # every ~2 days (144 = 1 day)
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(144, 1008), linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

p2<- traffic_10min %>%
  mutate(diff_144 = difference(Traffic_flow, lag = 144)) %>%
  PACF(diff_144, lag_max = 3000) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "PACF of 10-min Traffic Flow (Differenced at Lag 144)", x = "Lag (10-min intervals)", y = "PACF") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 288)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(144, 1008), linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)

pdf("ACF_PACF_10min_after_diff.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)  # TODO: re-enable for report export
grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)
dev.off()
```

# Train Test Split

```{r}
# Train/test split at May 10
traffic_train <- traffic_10min %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) <= as.Date("2020-05-10"))

traffic_test <- traffic_10min %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) > as.Date("2020-05-10"))

tail(traffic_train)
head(traffic_test)

cat("Test days implied:", nrow(traffic_test) / 144, "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Total 10-min observations:", nrow(traffic_10min), "\n")
cat("Any NAs?", sum(is.na(traffic_10min$Traffic_flow)), "\n")
cat("Train observations:", nrow(traffic_train), "\n")
cat("Test observations:", nrow(traffic_test), "\n")
```

```{r}
y_train <- traffic_train$Traffic_flow
```

# Actual matrix

```{r}
h       <- 144
n_train <- nrow(traffic_train)
n_test  <- nrow(traffic_test)
y_full  <- traffic_10min$Traffic_flow

actual_matrix_full <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_test, ncol = h)
for (i in 1:n_test) {
  test_start <- n_train + i
  test_end   <- test_start + h - 1
  if (test_end <= length(y_full)) {
    actual_matrix_full[i, ] <- y_full[test_start:test_end]
  }
}

cat("h =", h, " n_train =", n_train, " n_test =", n_test, "\n")
cat("actual_matrix_full dimensions:", dim(actual_matrix_full), "\n")
```

## Identifying Weekly Component


```{r}
FORECAST_ORIGINS <- 1000  
```

```{r}
# ── Coverage & interval width ────────────────────────
# actual, lower, upper are all (n_test x h) matrices, same shape as
# Coverage = proportion of actual values falling inside [lower bound, upper bound]
# Width    = average interval size (upper bound - lower bound)

coverage_width <- function(actual, lower, upper) {
  covered <- (actual >= lower) & (actual <= upper)
  list(
    coverage_overall = mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE),
    width_overall    = mean(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage_by_h    = colMeans(covered, na.rm = TRUE),   # for the h vs coverage plot
    width_by_h       = colMeans(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
msarima_full_path <- "fc_msarima_full.RData"

if (file.exists(msarima_full_path)) {

  message("[cache hit] loading ", msarima_full_path, " — skipping mSARIMA expanding window loop")
  load(msarima_full_path)

} else {

  n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cat("Running mSARIMA expanding window (", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "refits) across", n_workers, "workers...\n")

  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

  time_msarima_full <- system.time({
    results_msarima <- future_lapply(1:FORECAST_ORIGINS, function(i) {

      train_end_i <- n_train + i - 1
      y_train_i   <- y_full[1:train_end_i]

      tryCatch({
        fit_i <- smooth::msarima(
          y_train_i,
          lags   = c(1, 144, 1008),
          orders = list(
            ar = c(0, 1, 1),
            i  = c(1, 0, 0),
            ma = c(1, 2, 2)
          ),
          silent = TRUE
        )

        fc_i <- forecast::forecast(fit_i, h = h, interval = "parametric", level = 0.95)

        list(
          mean  = as.numeric(fc_i$mean),
          lower = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$lower)[, 1]),
          upper = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$upper)[, 1]),
          ok = TRUE, error = NA_character_
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(mean = rep(NA_real_, h), lower = rep(NA_real_, h), upper = rep(NA_real_, h),
             ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
      })

    }, future.seed = TRUE)
  })

  plan(sequential) # turns the parallelisation back off

  fc_msarima_full       <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "mean"))
  fc_msarima_full_lower <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "lower"))
  fc_msarima_full_upper <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "upper"))

  n_failed <- sum(!sapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "ok"))
  if (n_failed > 0) {
    cat(n_failed, "origin(s) failed to fit — filled with NA.\n")
    failed_idx <- which(!sapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "ok"))
    cat("Failed origins:", paste(head(failed_idx, 10), collapse = ", "),
        if (length(failed_idx) > 10) "..." else "", "\n")
  } else {
    cat("All", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "origins fit successfully.\n")
  }

  cat("mSARIMA loop time:", round(time_msarima_full["elapsed"] / 60, 2), "minutes\n")

  save(fc_msarima_full, fc_msarima_full_lower, fc_msarima_full_upper,
       file = msarima_full_path)
  cat("mSARIMA forecasts + 95% PI saved.\n")
}
```

# MSTL

```{r}
library(forecast)

y_train_msts <- msts(
  y_train,
  seasonal.periods = c(144, 1008)
)


# tune s.window, following Lisi & Grigoletto (2025):
# set the s.window value and other options to make the model work at its best, that is, minimizing the in-sample MAE"


s_window_candidates <- list(
  periodic = "periodic",
  default  = c(11, 15),                    # mstl()'s own default for 2 periods
  w7       = 7,   w9  = 9,   w11 = 11,
  w13      = 13,  w15 = 15,  w17 = 17,
  w19      = 19,  w21 = 21
)

time_stage1 <- system.time({
  stage1_results <- lapply(names(s_window_candidates), function(nm) {
    sw  <- s_window_candidates[[nm]]
    fit <- stlf(y_train_msts, method = "ets", s.window = sw, robust = FALSE)

    fitted_vals <- fitted(fit)
    mae  <- mean(abs(y_train - fitted_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_train - fitted_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

    cat(sprintf("s.window = %-10s MAE: %.5f  RMSE: %.5f\n", nm, mae, rmse))
    list(name = nm, s.window = sw, mae = mae, rmse = rmse, fit = fit)
  })
})
cat("Stage 1 tuning time:", time_stage1["elapsed"], "seconds\n")

best1    <- stage1_results[[which.min(sapply(stage1_results, `[[`, "mae"))]]
best_sw  <- best1$s.window
cat("\nStage 1 winner: s.window =", best1$name, " MAE =", round(best1$mae, 5), "\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 2: with the winning s.window fixed, tune the "other option"
# robust loess fitting (downweights outliers in the smoothing step)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

robust_candidates <- list(robust_off = FALSE, robust_on = TRUE)

time_stage2 <- system.time({
  stage2_results <- lapply(names(robust_candidates), function(nm) {
    rb  <- robust_candidates[[nm]]
    fit <- stlf(y_train_msts, method = "ets", s.window = best_sw, robust = rb)

    fitted_vals <- fitted(fit)
    mae  <- mean(abs(y_train - fitted_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_train - fitted_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

    cat(sprintf("robust = %-10s MAE: %.5f  RMSE: %.5f\n", nm, mae, rmse))
    list(name = nm, robust = rb, mae = mae, rmse = rmse, fit = fit)
  })
})
cat("Stage 2 tuning time:", time_stage2["elapsed"], "seconds\n")

best2 <- stage2_results[[which.min(sapply(stage2_results, `[[`, "mae"))]]
cat("\nStage 2 winner: robust =", best2$name, " MAE =", round(best2$mae, 5), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final model: winning s.window + winning robust setting
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

fit_mstl_fc <- best2$fit
fit_mstl    <- mstl(y_train_msts, s.window = best_sw, robust = best2$robust)

fitted_mstl <- fitted(fit_mstl_fc)
mae_mstl  <- mean(abs(y_train - fitted_mstl), na.rm = TRUE)
rmse_mstl <- sqrt(mean((y_train - fitted_mstl)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nFinal MSTL specification: s.window =", best1$name,
    " robust =", best2$name, "\n")
cat("Final MAE: ", mae_mstl,  "\n")
cat("Final RMSE:", rmse_mstl, "\n")

# Plot decomposition for the selected specification
plot(fit_mstl)

# Residual ACF
acf(as.numeric(residuals(fit_mstl_fc)), lag.max = 2500,
    main = paste0("MSTL Residual ACF (s.window=", best1$name,
                   ", robust=", best2$name, ")"))
abline(v = seq(144,  2500, by = 144),  col = "indianred", lty = 2)
abline(v = seq(1008, 2500, by = 1008), col = "darkblue",  lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# stlf()'s level is a PERCENTAGE (0-100) — level = 95, not 0.95. Different
# convention than mSARIMA/SARIMA above (smooth uses 0-1 proportions).
library(future.apply)
library(future)


mstl_full_path <- "fc_mstl_full.RData"

if (file.exists(mstl_full_path)) {

  message("[cache hit] loading ", mstl_full_path, " — skipping MSTL expanding window loop")
  load(mstl_full_path)

} else {

  n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cat("Running MSTL expanding window (", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "refits) across",
      n_workers, "workers...\n")

  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

  time_mstl_full <- system.time({
    results_mstl <- future_lapply(1:FORECAST_ORIGINS, function(i) {

      train_end_i    <- n_train + i - 1
      y_train_i      <- y_full[1:train_end_i]
      y_train_msts_i <- forecast::msts(y_train_i, seasonal.periods = c(144, 1008))

      tryCatch({
        fc_i <- forecast::stlf(
          y_train_msts_i,
          h        = h,
          method   = "ets",
          s.window = best_sw,       # winning setting from your Stage 1 tuning (w7 = 7)
          robust   = best2$robust,  # winning setting from your Stage 2 tuning (robust_off = FALSE)
          level    = 95
        )

        list(
          mean  = as.numeric(fc_i$mean),
          lower = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$lower)[, 1]),
          upper = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$upper)[, 1]),
          ok = TRUE, error = NA_character_
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(mean = rep(NA_real_, h), lower = rep(NA_real_, h), upper = rep(NA_real_, h),
             ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
      })

    }, future.seed = TRUE)
  })

  plan(sequential)

  fc_mstl_full       <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_mstl, `[[`, "mean"))
  fc_mstl_full_lower <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_mstl, `[[`, "lower"))
  fc_mstl_full_upper <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_mstl, `[[`, "upper"))

  n_failed <- sum(!sapply(results_mstl, `[[`, "ok"))
  if (n_failed > 0) {
    cat(n_failed, "origin(s) failed to fit — filled with NA.\n")
  } else {
    cat("All", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "origins fit successfully.\n")
  }

  cat("MSTL loop time:", round(time_mstl_full["elapsed"]/60, 2), "minutes\n")

  save(fc_mstl_full, fc_mstl_full_lower, fc_mstl_full_upper, file = mstl_full_path)
  cat("MSTL forecasts + 95% PI saved.\n")
}
```

# Prophet

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prophet: model identification (Fourier order + changepoint.prior.scale)
# and final model fit
# =========================================================

library(prophet)

prophet_train <- data.frame(
  ds = as.POSIXct(traffic_train$datetime, tz = "UTC"),
  y  = y_train
)
# ---- shared helper: build + fit a Prophet model for given settings ----
fit_prophet_model <- function(train_data, daily_k, weekly_k, cps) {
  m <- prophet(
    daily.seasonality  = FALSE,
    weekly.seasonality = FALSE,
    yearly.seasonality = FALSE,
    seasonality.mode   = "additive",
    changepoint.prior.scale = cps
  )
  m <- add_seasonality(m, name = "daily",  period = 1, fourier.order = daily_k)
  m <- add_seasonality(m, name = "weekly", period = 7, fourier.order = weekly_k)
  fit.prophet(m, train_data)
}

# ---- Stage 1: Fourier-order grid search (cps fixed at Prophet's default 0.05) ----
fourier_grid <- expand.grid(daily_order  = c(4, 6, 8, 10),
                             weekly_order = c(3, 5, 7, 10))

prophet_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fourier_grid)), function(i) {
  daily_k  <- fourier_grid$daily_order[i]
  weekly_k <- fourier_grid$weekly_order[i]

  fit <- fit_prophet_model(prophet_train, daily_k, weekly_k, cps = 0.05)
  fc  <- predict(fit, prophet_train)
  mae <- mean(abs(prophet_train$y - fc$yhat))

  data.frame(daily_order = daily_k, weekly_order = weekly_k, MAE = mae)
})
prophet_results <- do.call(rbind, prophet_results)
prophet_results <- prophet_results[order(prophet_results$MAE), ]
print(prophet_results)

# ---- Stage 1b: extend weekly_order at fixed daily_order = 10 ----
weekly_extend <- c(10, 13, 16, 20)

prophet_stage1b <- lapply(weekly_extend, function(weekly_k) {
  fit <- fit_prophet_model(prophet_train, daily_k = 10, weekly_k, cps = 0.05)
  fc  <- predict(fit, prophet_train)
  mae <- mean(abs(prophet_train$y - fc$yhat))
  data.frame(weekly_order = weekly_k, MAE = mae)
})
prophet_stage1b <- do.call(rbind, prophet_stage1b)
print(prophet_stage1b)

# ---- Stage 2: changepoint.prior.scale grid at fixed daily_k = 10, weekly_k = 20 ----
cps_grid <- c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5)

prophet_stage2 <- lapply(cps_grid, function(cps) {
  fit <- fit_prophet_model(prophet_train, daily_k = 10, weekly_k = 20, cps)
  fc  <- predict(fit, prophet_train)
  mae <- mean(abs(prophet_train$y - fc$yhat))
  data.frame(cps = cps, MAE = mae)
})
prophet_stage2 <- do.call(rbind, prophet_stage2)
print(prophet_stage2)

# ---- Final model: best settings from Stage 1/1b/2 ----
best_daily  <- 10
best_weekly <- 20
best_cps    <- 0.5

time_prophet_final <- system.time({
  fit_prophet <- fit_prophet_model(prophet_train, best_daily, best_weekly, best_cps)
})
cat("Final Prophet fitting time:", time_prophet_final["elapsed"], "seconds\n")

prophet_fitted <- predict(fit_prophet, prophet_train)

mae  <- mean(abs(prophet_train$y - prophet_fitted$yhat))
rmse <- sqrt(mean((prophet_train$y - prophet_fitted$yhat)^2))
cat("Final Prophet MAE:", mae, " RMSE:", rmse, "\n")

# ---- diagnostics ----
prophet_plot_components(fit_prophet, prophet_fitted)
acf(prophet_train$y - prophet_fitted$yhat, main = "Residual ACF - Prophet")
```

# Expand window
```{r}
library(future.apply)
library(future)

prophet_full_path <- "fc_prophet_full.RData"

if (file.exists(prophet_full_path)) {

  message("[cache hit] loading ", prophet_full_path, " — skipping Prophet expanding window loop")
  load(prophet_full_path)

} else {

  n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cat("Running Prophet expanding window (", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "refits) across",
      n_workers, "workers...\n")
  cat("Likely one of the slower models — expect a longer run even parallelized.\n")

  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

  time_prophet_full <- system.time({
    results_prophet <- future_lapply(1:FORECAST_ORIGINS, function(i) {

      train_end_i <- n_train + i - 1
      y_train_i   <- y_full[1:train_end_i]

      prophet_df <- data.frame(
        ds = as.POSIXct(traffic_10min$datetime[1:train_end_i], tz = "UTC"),
        y  = y_train_i
      )

      tryCatch({
        m_i <- prophet::prophet(
          daily.seasonality  = FALSE,
          weekly.seasonality = FALSE,
          yearly.seasonality = FALSE,
          seasonality.mode   = "additive",
          changepoint.prior.scale = 0.5,
          interval.width     = 0.95
        ) 
        m_i <- prophet::add_seasonality(m_i, name = "daily",  period = 1, fourier.order = 10)
        m_i <- prophet::add_seasonality(m_i, name = "weekly", period = 7, fourier.order = 20)
        fit_i <- suppressMessages(prophet::fit.prophet(m_i, prophet_df))

        future_df <- data.frame(
          ds = as.POSIXct(
            traffic_10min$datetime[(train_end_i + 1):(train_end_i + h)],
            tz = "UTC"
          )
        )

        fc_i <- predict(fit_i, future_df)

        list(mean = fc_i$yhat, lower = fc_i$yhat_lower, upper = fc_i$yhat_upper,
             ok = TRUE, error = NA_character_)
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(mean = rep(NA_real_, h), lower = rep(NA_real_, h), upper = rep(NA_real_, h),
             ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
      })

    }, future.seed = TRUE)
  })

  plan(sequential)

  fc_prophet_full       <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_prophet, `[[`, "mean"))
  fc_prophet_full_lower <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_prophet, `[[`, "lower"))
  fc_prophet_full_upper <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_prophet, `[[`, "upper"))

  n_failed <- sum(!sapply(results_prophet, `[[`, "ok"))
  if (n_failed > 0) {
    cat(n_failed, "origin(s) failed to fit — filled with NA.\n")
    failed_idx <- which(!sapply(results_prophet, `[[`, "ok"))
    cat("Failed origins:", paste(head(failed_idx, 10), collapse = ", "),
        if (length(failed_idx) > 10) "..." else "", "\n")
  } else {
    cat("All", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "origins fit successfully.\n")
  }

  cat("Prophet loop time:", round(time_prophet_full["elapsed"]/60, 2), "minutes\n")

  save(fc_prophet_full, fc_prophet_full_lower, fc_prophet_full_upper, file = prophet_full_path)
  cat("Prophet forecasts + 95% PI saved.\n")
}
```

# DHR

```{r}
k_grid <- expand.grid(K1 = c(4, 6, 8, 10), K2 = c(2, 3, 4, 6))

dhr_results <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(k_grid)) {
  K1 <- k_grid$K1[i]
  K2 <- k_grid$K2[i]

  time_dhr <- system.time({
    fit_dhr <- traffic_train %>%
      model(
        DHR = ARIMA(
          Traffic_flow ~
            fourier(period = 144,  K = K1) +
            fourier(period = 1008, K = K2) +
            PDQ(0,0,0)
        )
      )
  })

  fitted_dhr <- fitted(fit_dhr)$.fitted
  mae  <- mean(abs(y_train - fitted_dhr), na.rm = TRUE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_train - fitted_dhr)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  aicc <- glance(fit_dhr)$AICc

  dhr_results[[i]] <- tibble(K1 = K1, K2 = K2, MAE = mae, RMSE = rmse,
                              AICc = aicc, time_sec = time_dhr["elapsed"])

  cat("K1=", K1, "K2=", K2, "MAE=", round(mae, 2), "AICc=", round(aicc, 1),
      "time=", round(time_dhr["elapsed"], 1), "s\n")
}

dhr_summary <- bind_rows(dhr_results)
dhr_summary %>% arrange(MAE) %>% print(n = Inf)
report(fit_dhr)
```

```{r}
dhr_full_path <- "fc_dhr_full.RData"

if (file.exists(dhr_full_path)) {

  message("[cache hit] loading ", dhr_full_path, " — skipping DHR expanding window loop")
  load(dhr_full_path)

} else {

  n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cat("Running DHR expanding window (", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "refits) across", n_workers, "workers...\n")

  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

  time_dhr_full <- system.time({
    results_dhr <- future_lapply(1:FORECAST_ORIGINS, function(i) {

      train_end_i <- n_train + i - 1
      train_i     <- traffic_10min %>% dplyr::slice(1:train_end_i)

      tryCatch({
        fit_i <- train_i %>%
          model(
            DHR = ARIMA(
              Traffic_flow ~
                fourier(period = 144,  K = 10) +
                fourier(period = 1008, K = 6) +
                pdq(2,1,3) +
                PDQ(0,0,0)
            )
          )

        fc_i   <- fit_i %>% forecast(h = h)
        hilo_i <- fabletools::hilo(fc_i, level = 95)

        list(
          mean  = fc_i$.mean,
          lower = hilo_i$`95%`$lower,
          upper = hilo_i$`95%`$upper,
          ok = TRUE, error = NA_character_
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(mean = rep(NA_real_, h), lower = rep(NA_real_, h), upper = rep(NA_real_, h),
             ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
      })

    }, future.seed = TRUE, future.packages = c("fable", "fabletools", "tsibble", "dplyr"))
  })

  plan(sequential)

  fc_dhr_full       <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_dhr, `[[`, "mean"))
  fc_dhr_full_lower <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_dhr, `[[`, "lower"))
  fc_dhr_full_upper <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_dhr, `[[`, "upper"))

  n_failed <- sum(!sapply(results_dhr, `[[`, "ok"))
  if (n_failed > 0) {
    cat(n_failed, "origin(s) failed to fit — filled with NA.\n")
  } else {
    cat("All", FORECAST_ORIGINS, "origins fit successfully.\n")
  }
  cat("DHR loop time:", round(time_dhr_full["elapsed"]/60, 2), "minutes\n")

  save(fc_dhr_full, fc_dhr_full_lower, fc_dhr_full_upper, file = dhr_full_path)
  cat("DHR forecasts + 95% PI saved.\n")
}
```

```{r}
       title = "MAE by forecast horizon, all models") +

p_rmse <- ggplot(horizon_df, aes(x = h, y = RMSE, color = Model)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Forecast horizon (10-min steps)", y = "RMSE",
       title = "RMSE by forecast horizon, all models") +

print(p_mae)
```

```{r}
library(forecast)

FORECAST_ORIGINS <- 1000
h <- 144

models <- list(
  mSARIMA = fc_msarima_full,
  SARIMA  = fc_sarima_full,
  TBATS   = fc_tbats_full,
  MSTL    = fc_mstl_full,
  Prophet = fc_prophet_full,
  DHR     = fc_dhr_full
)

actual <- actual_matrix_full[1:FORECAST_ORIGINS, ]

run_dm_grid <- function(power) {
  out <- data.frame()
  for (model_name in setdiff(names(models), "mSARIMA")) {
    for (hh in 1:h) {
      e_msarima <- models[["mSARIMA"]][, hh] - actual[, hh]
      e_other   <- models[[model_name]][, hh] - actual[, hh]
      ok <- complete.cases(e_msarima, e_other)
      if (sum(ok) > 10) {
        test <- tryCatch(
          dm.test(e_msarima[ok], e_other[ok], h = hh, power = power, alternative = "two.sided"),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(test)) {
          out <- rbind(out, data.frame(
            horizon = hh, model = model_name,
            dm_stat = unname(test$statistic), p_value = test$p.value,
            msarima_lower_error = mean(abs(e_msarima[ok])^power) < mean(abs(e_other[ok])^power)
          ))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

dm_mae  <- run_dm_grid(power = 1)   # matches paper's Fig 15 left panel (absolute loss)
dm_rmse <- run_dm_grid(power = 2)   # matches paper's Fig 15 right panel (square loss)

write.csv(dm_mae,  "dm_test_mae.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dm_rmse, "dm_test_rmse.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Summary: for each competitor, where does mSARIMA stop being significantly better?
library(dplyr)
summarize_dm <- function(df) {
  df %>% group_by(model) %>% summarise(
    pct_msarima_sig_better = mean(p_value < 0.05 & msarima_lower_error) * 100,
    pct_other_sig_better   = mean(p_value < 0.05 & !msarima_lower_error) * 100,
    last_horizon_msarima_wins = {
      idx <- which(p_value < 0.05 & msarima_lower_error)
      if (length(idx) > 0) max(horizon[idx]) else NA
    }
  )
}
summarize_dm(dm_mae)
summarize_dm(dm_rmse)
```

```{r}
models <- c("msarima", "sarima", "tbats", "mstl", "prophet", "dhr")
model_labels <- c(msarima = "mSARIMA", sarima = "SARIMA", tbats = "TBATS",
                   mstl = "MSTL", prophet = "Prophet", dhr = "DHR")
 
for (m in models) {
  mae_vec  <- get(paste0("mae_", m, "_full"))
  rmse_vec <- get(paste0("rmse_", m, "_full"))
  pi_obj   <- get(paste0(m, "_pi"))
  fc_mat   <- get(paste0("fc_", m, "_full"))
  fc_lo    <- get(paste0("fc_", m, "_full_lower"))
  fc_hi    <- get(paste0("fc_", m, "_full_upper"))
  label    <- model_labels[[m]]

  pdf(paste0(m, "_mae_by_horizon.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
  plot(mae_vec, xlab = "Forecast horizon", ylab = "MAE",
       main = paste(label, "\u2014 MAE by horizon"))
  dev.off()

  pdf(paste0(m, "_rmse_by_horizon.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
  plot(rmse_vec, xlab = "Forecast horizon", ylab = "RMSE",
       main = paste(label, "\u2014 RMSE by horizon"))
  dev.off()

  pdf(paste0(m, "_coverage_by_horizon.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
  plot(pi_obj$coverage_by_h, ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Forecast horizon",
       ylab = "Coverage", main = paste(label, "\u2014 95% PI coverage by horizon"))
  abline(h = 0.95, col = "red")
  dev.off()

  pdf(paste0(m, "_width_by_horizon.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
  plot(pi_obj$width_by_h, xlab = "Forecast horizon", ylab = "PI width",
       main = paste(label, "\u2014 95% PI width by horizon"))
  dev.off()

  for (origin in c(1, 40)) {
    pdf(paste0(m, "_forecast_origin", origin, ".pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
    plot(fc_mat[origin, ], ylim = c(100, 1800), type = "l",
         xlab = "Horizon step", ylab = "Traffic flow",
         main = paste(label, "origin", origin, "\u2014 forecast vs actual"))
    lines(fc_lo[origin, ]); lines(fc_hi[origin, ])
    lines(actual_matrix_full[origin, ], col = "red")
    dev.off()
  }
}
```
